$description: Fugleramme animation tokens. Defines timing for the dashboard/display flip (US-003), bird detection entrance/exit (US-004), and micro-interactions. Values are CSS-consumable strings unless noted.

duration.$description: Named durations. All values in milliseconds (ms) and seconds (s) for CSS.

normal.$note: Standard UI transitions: panel expand, tooltip

easing.$description: Named CSS timing functions. Choose based on physical feel of the motion.

easeIn.$note: Starts slow, accelerates — element leaving the screen

easeOut.$note: Starts fast, decelerates — element entering the screen

spring.$note: Slight overshoot/bounce — bird illustration landing, Hero Button press release

snap.$note: Fast start, firm deceleration — flip transition arrival

organic.$note: Natural, slightly asymmetric — illustration fade-in, evokes living motion

flip.$description: Dashboard ↔ Fugleramme display flip transition (US-003). The display is an immersive overlay; the flip must feel weighty and deliberate.

outDuration.$note: Duration for dashboard to fade/scale out

inDuration.$note: Duration for display to fade/scale in

inEasing.$note: Ease-out — display arrives decelerating into place

inDelay.$note: Display starts fading in after dashboard is mostly hidden (400ms into out animation)

totalDuration.$note: Total perceptible duration of the flip gesture (out + overlap + in)

scrimPeak.$note: Midpoint at which the scrim overlay is at full opacity

reverseOutDuration.$note: Display → dashboard (triple-tap return). Faster than initial flip — feels responsive.

detection.$description: New bird detection entering and leaving the display canvas (US-004 AC 6 and 9).

entranceDuration.$note: How long a new bird illustration takes to fully appear. Ease-out fade from opacity 0 → 1, slight scale 0.92 → 1.

entranceEasing.$note: Organic ease-out — bird illustration settles onto the page

entranceScaleFrom.$note: Starting scale for entrance. Subtle — not a dramatic zoom, just a gentle materialise.

exitDuration.$note: Bird fades out after configurable linger duration (default 60s per US-004 AC 9). Slower than entrance — a gentle departure.

exitEasing.$note: Ease-in — fade accelerates toward end; the bird dissolves away

repositionDuration.$note: When a new detection causes other illustrations to reflow/reposition on the canvas. Use CSS transition on transform.

staggerIncrement.$note: Stagger delay per additional illustration when multiple birds arrive simultaneously (e.g. on initial load). Multiply by index.

emptyState.$description: Display empty-state perch/branch illustration (US-004 AC 7). No text — illustration only.

appearDuration.$note: Unhurried fade-in of the bare perch illustration on initial load or when all birds clear

disappearDuration.$note: Perch fades out before first bird appears

microInteraction.$description: Small, immediate feedback animations. Keep these snappy — do not let them feel laggy.

buttonHoverDuration.$note: Background colour shift on hover — fast, not jarring

buttonReleaseEasing.$note: Spring ease-out on release — Hero Button bounces back with confidence

focusRingDuration.$note: Focus ring fade-in — must be immediate to feel responsive to keyboard navigation

toastEnterDuration.$note: Status toast slide+fade in from bottom

tripleTap.$description: Feedback timing for the triple-tap return gesture (US-003 AC 6–9). Visual feedback must confirm each tap without prematurely revealing the dashboard.

windowMs.$note: Three taps must occur within 1500ms (US-003 AC 6)

rippleDuration.$note: Each tap spawns a brief radial ripple on the display canvas to confirm the tap was registered

resetFeedback.$note: Brief visual flash if counter resets (timeout) — subtle, does not break immersion

reducedMotion.$description: Fallback durations when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active. Preserve opacity transitions but collapse transform/scale animations.

microInteraction.$note: No hover animation; state changes are instant

reducedMotion.$implementationNote: Web must honour @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by swapping to these tokens. Remove all transform transitions; keep opacity only.
